Shows proposed government buildings. Relief shown by hachures. Also covers Georgetown. From A. van der Kroe's Vaderlandsche letter-oefeningen waarin boeken en schriften, Amsterdam, 1793. Includes latitude/longitude statement. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. LC copy foxed, fold-lined, laminated, and mounted on cloth backing. Phillips. Washington 1287 DCP
